verdict.rationale:
Zoho Books ships a documented REST API with full parity to the app plus a vendor-hosted MCP server that explicitly connects LLMs (GPT/Claude) to 'Zoho's APIs, data models, and actions' and lets agents 'pull reports just by asking,' with customer testimonials describing month-end closures and bookkeeping done via Claude/OpenClaw. This plausibly supports an agent answering an affordability question by pulling live ledger/report data, but no evidence shows this exact query pattern ('can we afford X') working end-to-end or being validated for accuracy/groundedness.
missing for 10: a concrete example or hands-on test of an agent answering a cash-affordability question grounded in live API/ledger data, and independent verification that MCP-sourced answers are accurate rather than hallucinated.
